entries.title: Hebrews 12:1
segments: Seeing, therefore, that there is on every side of us such a throng of witnesses, let us also lay aside everything that hinders us, and the sin that clings about us, and run with patient endurance the race that lies before us,

entries.title: Hebrews 12:2
segments: our eyes fixed upon Jesus, the Leader and perfect Example of our faith, who, for the joy that lay before him, endured the cross, heedless of its shame, and now 'has taken his seat at the right hand' of the throne of God.

entries.title: Hebrews 12:3
segments: Weigh well the example of him who had to endure such opposition from 'men who were sinning against themselves,' so that you should not grow weary or faint-hearted.

entries.title: Hebrews 12:4
segments: You have not yet, in your struggle with sin, resisted to the death;

entries.title: Hebrews 12:5
segments: and you have forgotten the encouraging words which are addressed to you as God's Children-- 'My child, think not lightly of the Lord's discipline, do not despond when he rebukes you;

entries.title: Hebrews 12:6
segments: for it is him whom he loves that he disciplines, and he chastises every child whom he acknowledges.'

entries.title: Hebrews 12:7
segments: It is for your discipline that you have to endure all this. God is dealing with you as his Children. For where is there a child whom his father does not discipline?

entries.title: Hebrews 12:8
segments: If you are left without that discipline, in which all children share, it shows that you are bastards, and not true Children.

entries.title: Hebrews 12:9
segments: Further, when our earthly fathers disciplined us, we respected them. Shall we not, then, much rather yield submission to the Father of souls, and live?

entries.title: Hebrews 12:10
segments: Our fathers disciplined us for only a short time and as seemed best to them; but God disciplines us for our true good, to enable us to share his holiness.

entries.title: Hebrews 12:11
segments: No discipline is pleasant at the time; on the contrary, it is painful. But afterwards its fruit is seen in the peacefulness of a righteous life which is the lot of those who have been trained under it.

entries.title: Hebrews 12:12
segments: Therefore 'lift again the down-dropped hands and straighten the weakened knees;

entries.title: Hebrews 12:13
segments: make straight paths for your feet,' so that the lame limb may not be put out of joint, but rather be cured.

entries.title: Hebrews 12:14
segments: Try earnestly to live at peace with every one, and to attain to that purity without which no one will see the Lord.

entries.title: Hebrews 12:15
segments: Take care that no one fails to use the loving help of God, 'that no bitterness is allowed to take root and spring up, and cause trouble,' and so poison the whole community.

entries.title: Hebrews 12:16
segments: Take care that no one becomes immoral, or irreligious like Esau, who sold his birthright for a single meal.

entries.title: Hebrews 12:17
segments: For you know that even afterwards, when he wished to claim his father's blessing, he was rejected--for he never found an opportunity to repair his error--though he begged for the blessing with tears.

entries.title: Hebrews 12:18
segments: It is not to tangible 'flaming fire' that you have drawn near, nor to 'gloom, and darkness, and storm,

entries.title: Hebrews 12:19
segments: and the blast of a trumpet, and an audible voice.' Those who heard that voice entreated that they might hear no more,

entries.title: Hebrews 12:20
segments: for they could not bear to think of the command-- 'If even an animal touches the mountain, it is to be stoned to death;'

entries.title: Hebrews 12:21
segments: and so fearful was the sight that Moses said-- 'I tremble with fear.'

entries.title: Hebrews 12:22
segments: No, but it is to Mount Zion that you have drawn near, the City of the Living God, the heavenly Jerusalem, to countless hosts of angels,

entries.title: Hebrews 12:23
segments: to the festal gathering and assemblage of God's Eldest Sons whose names are enrolled in Heaven, to God the Judge of all men, to the spirits of the righteous who have attained perfection,

entries.title: Hebrews 12:24
segments: to Jesus, the intermediary of a new Covenant, and to the Sprinkled Blood that tells of better things than the blood of Abel.

entries.title: Hebrews 12:25
segments: Beware how you refuse to hear him who is speaking. For, if the Israelites did not escape punishment, when they refused to listen to him who taught them on earth the divine will, far worse will it be for us, if we turn away from him who is teaching us from Heaven.

entries.title: Hebrews 12:26
segments: Then his voice shook the earth, but now his declaration is-- 'Still once more I will cause not only the earth to tremble, but also the heavens.'

entries.title: Hebrews 12:27
segments: And those words 'still once more' indicate the passing away of all that is shaken--that is, of all created things--in order that only what is unshaken may remain.

entries.title: Hebrews 12:28
segments: Therefore, let us, who have received a kingdom that cannot be shaken, be thankful, and so offer acceptable worship to God, with awe and reverence.

entries.title: Hebrews 12:29
segments: For our God is 'a consuming fire.'
